Rachel Lynde is a fat woman who always waddles when she walks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

A capable, hardworking, and farseeing woman, Rachel Lynde is an active church worker who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. Though her outspoken nature can sometimes be viewed as overly blunt, she is well-intentioned, kind at heart, and willing to admit her own mistakes. She also enjoys sewing.

## History

Before [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mrs. Rachel Lynde had brought up ten children, buried two, and knitted sixteen cotton warp quilts. When she observed [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) driving away in his best clothes, she visited [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and was thoroughly shocked to learn the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) intended to adopt an orphan boy. Upon meeting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Rachel made blunt, critical remarks about the girl's red hair, provoking a furious outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gave a dramatically thorough apology at Rachel's house, Rachel forgave her and offered her hope regarding her hair color. Rachel later advised [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home from school until she cooled off following an incident with her teacher, and she subsequently informed [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) blamed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for accidentally intoxicating [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) jumped on [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) in a spare-room bed, Rachel's report of Aunt Josephine's anger prompted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to go apologize. Later, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) enlisted Rachel to help select and sew a modern dress with puffed sleeves for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a Christmas gift. Over the following years, Rachel praised Anne's development, praised her tied first-place standing on the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, and mourned alongside the community when [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died of sudden heart failure.

## Quotes

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I was kind of afraid you weren’t, though, when I saw Matthew starting off today. I thought maybe he was going to the doctor’s."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "I don’t know it. I guess you’re going to teach right here in Avonlea. The trustees have decided to give you the school."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) had a turbulent first meeting when Rachel made blunt remarks about Anne's red hair, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a rage and insult her back. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offered a dramatically thorough apology at Rachel's house, Rachel readily forgave her and even offered comfort regarding her hair. Since then, Rachel has provided sensible advice to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's upbringing, such as letting her stay home from school when she was upset.

- Friend of — forgiven acquaintance  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P46](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0046)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are long-time neighbors and close confidantes who regularly exchange news and advice. Their relationship began on a note of shock when Rachel learned of Marilla's plan to adopt an orphan, but they continue to rely on each other for counsel regarding domestic life and child-rearing. Though listed as comrades traveling to a political meeting in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), their primary bond is that of constant, supportive neighbors.

- Comrade of — traveling together to a political mass meeting in Charlottetown  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001)</sub>
- Friend of — neighbors who consult each other for advice  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P40](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0040), +1 more</sub>
